scope: Bounded search for all111native Token codes whose existing API source provides only generator art or no art. Multiple references are compared by identity and composition, not counted from scan crops or resolutions.

acceptedPrintedTokenScans.basis: printed Token name/type/level/stat definition plus native generator association; printed Token cards may have no printed numeric passcode

threeDimensionalCertification: None. Rear views, occluded anatomy, interpretation of composition and copy-dependent Tokens remain explicitly limited.

protectedAmbiguities.WorldLegacy69811711: No appearance association applied; printed modern spirit and old game machine remain distinct references.
protectedAmbiguities.Parasomnia44092305: Neutral echo preserved; retrieved game display/generator art does not identify the copied monster.
protectedAmbiguities.Epigonos51611042: Neutral echo preserved; retrieved game display/generator art does not identify the copied monster.
protectedAmbiguities.CrystalBeast58371672: Printed gems identify a presentation; copied Token type/level/stats/monster appearance remain variable.
protectedAmbiguities.DuelDragon60025884: Printed art is a presentation, not a fixed copied monster appearance.
protectedAmbiguities.PrankKids43664495: Printed composition includes several different group members; no invented single canonical member selected.
